data.one_liner: Mobile sensing framework for collecting sensor and wearable data in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: A software framework for collecting sensor data and device events from phones and attached wearables via probes. Supports defining study protocols, deploying them locally or remotely, and handling background data sampling and storage.
use_when: You need to build a digital phenotyping or mHealth application that collects continuous sensor data
You want to schedule and execute background sensing tasks on mobile devices
avoid_when: You only need to query a single device sensor once without setting up a study framework
You are not targeting Android or iOS mobile sensing use cases
strengths: Extensible architecture for triggers, tasks, measures, and probes
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
Built-in support for local SQLite storage and background execution
weaknesses: Requires complex native setup for background services and notifications
Steep learning curve due to extensive domain models and protocol definitions
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring flutter_local_notifications for Android and iOS, setting up flutter_background for Android background sensing, and adding specific permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist depending on the probes used.
